title: Is it Time to Buy Gold & Bonds?
speaker: Chris and Nick (A1 Trading)

macro_themes.view: Fed pauses through October, maybe another hike in December; CPI/PPI next week are key.
2s10s jumped from ~20 to ~46 bp; over 80-100 bp would be a recession warning.
Like oil, sharply higher yields eventually break the economy (Europe first), which then makes bonds attractive.
Watching SMH and MAGS largely determines whether the market has a bullish or bearish day.

calls.reason: Despite a pop on soft jobs data, gold may come back in to test its previous lows.
calls.quote: I still think gold might be coming in to check those previous lows.

notes: Date inferred: 'today's data' was the soft jobs report (Friday 2026-10-02); listing approx 10-03. Gold is the only directional call; yields/euro discussion is descriptive (in macro_themes). No price levels given.
